_comment: EXAMPLE roster. Copy to orch/roster.json (git-ignored) and replace every entry with models you can really launch; the ids below are placeholders. Fields: docs/MODELS.md. workloads = what `orch pick` may propose the model for ([] = never proposed). lane local => XS/S slices only and one run at a time. requires_permission => never proposed by pick, and `orch run` needs --owner-approved-model. Only list models an orch adapter (opencode, vibe, codex, agy) can launch.

models.playbook_note: XS/S edits and tests; task-level review with a small file list
untested: tool-call smoke test first; not proposed until then
whole-branch reviewer; use an id agy knows, or attribution is unknown
only with the owner's permission for that run
